coursework.title: Module A quiz · completion target
coursework.description: Published individual Canvas quiz: 12 questions, at least 10 correct answers required. Multiple attempts are allowed. Complete all four quizzes (A–D) by 30 October; if you finish them later, email fki@kth.se. This is the teacher's completion target, not a Canvas submission cutoff; Canvas currently lists the quizzes as undated. Study Module A and its exercises first.
